# PC Guru — Hungarian retrospective

- Original title: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood teszt
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.pcguru.hu/teszt/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood-teszt/1571)
- Author / publisher: lolyci; PC Guru
- Language / date: Hungarian; 2014-07-20
- Access: Complete review inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

lolyci praises the adaptation, coherent story, music, scenery, camp management, traps, and differing civilian behavior. The central criticism is that dense enemy placement and easy mass combat undermine the incentive to sneak and spare lives. Robin’s bow also feels less important than expected.

The verdict is mixed: a successful adaptation with a combat system that weakens the tactical challenge. The page renders a zero-percent score despite positive prose; that apparent placeholder is not treated as a reliable rating.
